paper.title: Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning

blocks.original_text: Reinforcement learning, high-dimensional sensory input, and the representation problem.
blocks.translation: 强化学习、高维感知输入与表示问题。

blocks.original_text: DQN learns policies from pixels and game score across 49 Atari games.
blocks.translation: DQN 从像素与游戏得分学习策略，并在 49 款 Atari 游戏上评估。

blocks.original_text: A single algorithm combines reinforcement learning and deep convolutional networks.
blocks.translation: 单一算法结合强化学习与深度卷积网络。

blocks.original_text: Definition of the optimal action-value function.
blocks.translation: 最优动作价值函数的定义。

blocks.original_text: Sources of instability and the experience-replay and target-network remedies.
blocks.translation: 不稳定性的来源，以及经验回放和目标网络的应对机制。

blocks.original_text: Replay-memory sampling and the DQN loss.
blocks.translation: 回放记忆采样与 DQN 损失函数。

blocks.original_text: A common architecture and training setup is applied to 49 Atari games.
blocks.translation: 同一架构与训练设置用于 49 款 Atari 游戏。

blocks.original_text: DQN is compared with prior methods, random play and a professional human tester.
blocks.translation: DQN 与既有方法、随机策略及专业人类测试员比较。

blocks.original_text: Ablations test replay memory, a separate target network and deep convolutional representation.
blocks.translation: 消融实验检验回放记忆、独立目标网络和深度卷积表示。

blocks.original_text: t-SNE analysis of learned state representations and generalization across policies.
blocks.translation: 使用 t-SNE 分析学得的状态表示及跨策略泛化。

blocks.original_text: DQN succeeds in diverse games but struggles with extended planning.
blocks.translation: DQN 在多类游戏中成功，但仍难以进行长时规划。

blocks.original_text: A single end-to-end architecture learns control policies with minimal prior knowledge.
blocks.translation: 单一端到端架构以极少先验知识学习控制策略。

blocks.original_text: Replay is connected to biological inspiration and future prioritized replay.
blocks.translation: 经验回放与生物学启发及未来的优先回放方向相联系。

blocks.original_text: Acknowledgements, author contributions and competing-interest statement.
blocks.translation: 致谢、作者贡献与利益冲突声明。

blocks.original_text: Frame preprocessing removes flicker, extracts luminance, rescales and stacks four frames.
blocks.translation: 帧预处理消除闪烁、提取亮度、缩放并堆叠四帧。

blocks.original_text: Code-availability statement.
blocks.translation: 代码可用性声明。

blocks.original_text: Detailed convolutional-network architecture.
blocks.translation: 卷积神经网络详细架构。

blocks.original_text: Per-game training with shared settings and clipped rewards.
blocks.translation: 各游戏独立训练、共享设置并裁剪奖励。

blocks.original_text: RMSProp, epsilon schedule, replay size, frame skipping and hyperparameter selection.
blocks.translation: RMSProp、探索率计划、回放大小、跳帧和超参数选择。

blocks.original_text: Minimal prior knowledge and agent evaluation procedure.
blocks.translation: 最小先验知识与智能体评估程序。

blocks.original_text: Controlled professional-human evaluation.
blocks.translation: 受控的专业人类评估。

blocks.original_text: Partial observability and history as state.
blocks.translation: 部分可观测性以及以历史序列作为状态。

blocks.original_text: Discounted return, Bellman equation and function approximation.
blocks.translation: 折扣回报、贝尔曼方程与函数逼近。

blocks.original_text: Q-network Bellman-error optimization.
blocks.translation: Q 网络的贝尔曼误差优化。

blocks.original_text: Model-free, off-policy learning with epsilon-greedy exploration.
blocks.translation: 无模型、离策略学习与 ε-贪心探索。

blocks.original_text: Benefits and limitations of experience replay.
blocks.translation: 经验回放的优势与局限。

blocks.original_text: Target-network delay and clipped TD error.
blocks.translation: 目标网络延迟与 TD 误差裁剪。

blocks.original_text: Algorithm 1: deep Q-learning with experience replay.
blocks.translation: 算法 1：带经验回放的深度 Q 学习。
